record.paper_title: Harvesting and stocking in discrete-time contest competition models with open problems and conjectures
record.original_question: For the normalized delayed Pielou harvesting equation x_{n+1} = b x_n/(1 + x_{n-1}) - h with b > 1 and 0 < h < 1, are all persistent solutions whose terms are eventually larger than the lower positive equilibrium xbar_{1,h} attracted to the upper positive equilibrium xbar_{2,h}?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the normalized delayed Pielou harvesting difference equation
  x_{n+1} = b x_n / (1 + x_{n-1}) − h,  n = 0, 1, 2, …,
with real parameters b > 1 and 0 < h < 1, and positive initial values x_{-1}, x_0. The positive equilibria are the positive roots of x = bx/(1+x) − h, i.e. solutions of x^2 + (1 − b + h)x + h = 0. When these roots are real and positive, denote them by 0 < x̄_{1,h} < x̄_{2,h} (the lower and upper positive equilibria).

A solution {x_n} is called persistent if it remains positive for all n ≥ -1 and stays bounded away from 0 and from ∞.

Question: For every choice of parameters (b, h) with b > 1 and 0 < h < 1 for which both positive equilibria exist, is it true that every persistent solution {x_n} whose terms eventually satisfy x_n > x̄_{1,h} converges to the upper equilibrium x̄_{2,h} as n → ∞?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a conjecture about the delayed Pielou harvesting equation. Literature on related discrete delay logistic and Pielou-type harvesting models discusses stability and persistence but does not establish the conjectured global attractivity of the upper equilibrium for all persistent solutions exceeding the lower equilibrium. No source verifying a resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: The dynamics of some discrete models with delay under the effect of constant yield harvesting
status_evidence.snippet: Studies dynamics of x_{n+1}=x_n f(x_{n-1}) under constant yield harvesting, including persistence and stability questions.
status_evidence.claim: Related work studies the same family of delayed harvesting models but leaves the attractivity of the upper equilibrium as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Oscillation and global attractivity in a discrete delay logistic model
status_evidence.snippet: Pielou's discrete delay logistic model is globally asymptotically stable under (α−1)(k−1) ≤ 1; broader attractivity remains conjectural.
status_evidence.claim: Global attractivity conjectures for delayed Pielou-type equations are still under investigation.
